versions.subject: Rule: Dridex pattern
versions.detection:
condition: 1 of them
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine: '*\svchost.exe C:\Users\*\Desktop\*'
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage: '*\svchost.exe*'
    CommandLine: 
        - '*whoami.exe /all'
        - '*net.exe view'
selection:
    EventID: 4688
    ProcessCommandLine: '*\svchost.exe C:\Users\*\Desktop\*'
versions.spl: (EventID=1 CommandLine="*\\svchost.exe C:\\Users\*\\Desktop\*") OR (EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe*" CommandLine IN ("*whoami.exe /all", "*net.exe view")) OR (EventID=4688 ProcessCommandLine="*\\svchost.exe C:\\Users\*\\Desktop\*")

versions.subject: Escaped '\*' to '\\*' where required
versions.detection:
condition: 1 of them
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine: '*\svchost.exe C:\Users\\*\Desktop\\*'
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage: '*\svchost.exe*'
    CommandLine: 
        - '*whoami.exe /all'
        - '*net.exe view'
selection:
    EventID: 4688
    ProcessCommandLine: '*\svchost.exe C:\Users\\*\Desktop\\*'
versions.spl: (EventID=1 CommandLine="*\\svchost.exe C:\\Users\\*\\Desktop\\*") OR (EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe*" CommandLine IN ("*whoami.exe /all", "*net.exe view")) OR (EventID=4688 ProcessCommandLine="*\\svchost.exe C:\\Users\\*\\Desktop\\*")
